statement: The WiiBrew MotionPlus documentation identifies a 32-byte calibration region at 0xA60020 with distinct fast/slow yaw-roll-pitch zero/scale blocks, degree-per-six encoding, a per-block UID byte and split CRC32 covering calibration data except checksum fields. Dolphin's MotionPlus calibration model uses the same structural arrangement, but the underlying factory values and variant-specific validity remain unmeasured by this research lane.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 120079 calibration section; pinned Dolphin MotionPlus.h lines 29-70, cpp 145-153. No physical dumps or default calibration byte values reproduced.
